python_ds3231_init.message0: initialize DS3231 %1 using I2C %2 (empty uses board I2C)
python_ds3231_init.tooltip: Create a DS3231 RTC using an existing I2C object or an owned board.I2C bus when empty.

python_ds3231_datetime.tooltip: Read the RTC date and time as a time.struct_time value.

python_ds3231_set_datetime.message0: set DS3231 %1 date and time to %2
python_ds3231_set_datetime.tooltip: Set from a datetime, struct_time, or sequence from year through second. Year must be 2000–2099; fields are validated and weekday is recomputed.

python_ds3231_temperature.tooltip: Read the most recently converted DS3231 temperature in degrees Celsius.

python_ds3231_force_temperature.tooltip: Force a fresh temperature conversion and return the result in degrees Celsius.

python_ds3231_lost_power.tooltip: Return whether the RTC reports that its clock data may be invalid after power loss.

python_ds3231_calibration.tooltip: Read the signed DS3231 aging-offset calibration value.

python_ds3231_set_calibration.tooltip: Set the signed calibration value; values outside -128 through 127 raise ValueError.

python_ds3231_close.tooltip: Release an I2C bus created by the initialization block; externally supplied buses remain open.
